points.description: The answer conveys that sizeof returns the size, in bytes, of its operand (the amount of memory the operand occupies). Equivalent wording such as 'the number of bytes taken up by the operand' or 'memory size of the operand in bytes' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single sentence expressing one idea, so the scheme has one all-or-nothing point worth the full 5 marks. Full marks go to any answer stating that sizeof gives the operand's size in bytes; no marks go to answers giving a different quantity (such as a value, count of elements, or type) or no answer.
